mentions.name: Red Candle
mentions.description: A Ruby gem that runs LLMs (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi) directly in the Ruby process via Rust bindings based on Hugging Face's candle crate, using FFI with Metal/CUDA acceleration—no Python or separate servers—so Rails apps can add AI features without managing separate services.
mentions.problem: Running LLMs in Ruby typically requires the complexity of managing separate Python services or servers.
mentions.audience: Anyone working with LLMs in Ruby, e.g. developers adding AI features to Rails apps.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on Red Candle, a Ruby gem that runs LLMs (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi) directly in your Ruby process through Rust bindings (based on the candle crate from Hugging Face). No Python, no servers - just FFI with Metal/CUDA acceleration.
